title: hot girl summer
body: i was planning on using the official app but i don't want to pay a subscription. this is a great alternative and i love that you can customize your tasks!! (do a kind act, meditate, sleep amount, etc) it was kind of hard to figure out how to get past the subscription but you just have to look super hard for the X (it's basically the same color but a bit lighter/darker).

title: Made a fan outta me
body: So far, I have been using the app and in competition with a few coworkers of mine. We are not paying for anything, we're just using the free option but so far honestly it's been the best. It is really good on holding you accountable and keeping everyone motivated.

title: Shady Business Practices
body: I bought one of the plans from this company that ignored every answer I gave and provided an AI generated plan that was BS. The app doesn't match the plans at all and there is no way to connect the two. Every attempt at logging into the app doesn't work - as soon as I click on another screen then go back to account, I'm prompted to log in again. Subscriptions also don't appear in your apple subscription manager. I never signed up for a subscription - only bought the initial plan 4 months ago - and suddenly I'm subscribed for $8

title: Expected more. Somewhat glitchy.
body: I expected a little more out of the paid version of this app. I'm now on day 21. First, the day number constantly glitches to day 1 on both the widget and in the app. Second, I really thought when I bought the pro version, I'd get more widget options. One thing I don't like is after completing the day in the widget, it only gives options to share to social media. I don't want to share each completed day. It'd be nice to customize that to just say congrats.

title: Great app
body: I think it's an awesome app that helps me stay excited and organized with my friends in this challenge! All I could recommend to the creators are to maybe have a little more description in each step of what's going on when registering cause we had a lot of confusion at first. The invite flow can be confusing.

title: love love love
body: This is going to sound dramatic, but this app changed my life. I've done these challenges before, but this simple list made my life so much easier. Being able to check off my daily tasks was easy, especially the water tracker. I've done Hard 75 with this and now am working on a Soft 30. Everything is modifiable to your needs. Also love that it isn't aggressive like some 75 Hard apps are. If you forget to check something off, it just asks if you're still on track. What would be so super fun and cool is if something fun happened at the completion. I was expecting confetti or something!

title: Great app for my lifestyle
body: I used the 75 Day Challenge more as a lifestyle reset than an extreme challenge. I focused on consistency over perfection — 10k steps a day, eating within my calorie budget. The app makes it easy to stay on track without feeling obsessive, and the widget is a huge win. Seeing my progress front and center every day kept me motivated and accountable without overthinking it.

title: Consistent Developer
body: For 75 hard challenge it's a really great app to keep track. The free options are still fairly robust compared to other apps. Possible to ask for calendar marking down to 75 on free version would be awesome. At first I was disappointed by how much is locked behind the paid version. However, seeing how helpful and consistent with updates from the developer, the paid version is more of an appreciation for the consistent work done after years of this app.

title: Happy overall - widget needs work
body: Really liking the app overall! I like the ability to see current and past days, the check in reminders are good, and I love that you can customize. On day 20 of 75 medium! my only major complaint is that the widget and the app don't talk to each other well. If I cross something off on the widget, it usually doesn't register as done in the app, and I have to cross it off again in the app. Only deleting the widget and restarting the app has worked to clear this.

title: Scam
body: This app has a monthly recurring subscription however they have been charging me four times a month since January. I've attempted to cancel my subscription and have found no way to cancel it as it's no longer connected to my Apple ID. It was somehow linked to my entire family account. Every time I ask for help to cancel my subscription, they say they can't unless we can figure out which Apple account is subscribed to it.
